_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: The services holding your history do not keep it for you. This extension saves it to your own Companion Memory.

sign-in.text: You sign in once through your CI-Portal account, and the extension looks for your Memory there. It follows your system's light or dark setting.

what-it-saves.text: It saves the pages you visit, your bookmarks and downloads, and any passage you highlight. The first three each get their own switch.

site-profiles.text: Thirteen sites get their own profile, so what you watched, read or booked is filed as titles and dates. Each runs only on its own site.

controls.text: Ignore any site or page and nothing from it is uploaded. Pause capture whenever you like. The extension never asks for cookie access.

where-it-goes.text: Captures go to your Memory. Sign-in goes through CI-Portal, which learns who you are, never what you saved. Crash reports are anonymous, with one switch to turn them off.

close.text: Keep your history yours, with the Companion Intelligence browser extension. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
